actual_scope: At p=19, beta0=-1/2, bandwidth 2, and t_i=i, is this section's polynomial-inverse error strictly below 2^{-76}?
scope_change_reason: The preceding audit shows the section error is strictly below (319/100) exp(-361), which is strictly below 2^{-57}. The named next step is the comparison with 2^{-76}.
bottleneck_link: FINE-PRIME.md says the polynomial error is below 2^{-Cp} for every fixed C eventually. At C=4 the degree-13 Taylor sum of exp(361) exceeds 2^{76}*(319/100), so the section error is strictly below 2^{-76}.
stop_rule: Stop once (319/100) exp(-361) is compared with 2^{-76}. Do not form Q and do not compare a larger C.
evidence: research/gaussian-origin-two-power-c4 replays the preceding bound and checks that the degree-13 Taylor sum of exp(361) equals 917160294948960776428552987246843/3113510400, which is strictly above 6025739632141667292676096/25 = 2^{76}*(319/100). The degree-12 sum is strictly below that target, and the next Taylor term is positive, so (319/100) exp(-361) < 2^{-76}.
